item.title: How tomato 'golden hour' research could help crops survive heat waves and drought
item.description: What if the secret to drought-resistant crops isn't how much water plants use, but when they use it? A new study identifies a daily window that could help breeders develop tomatoes that better withstand drought without sacrificing yield. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Varios sectores de la capital peruana son afectados por inundaciones
item.description: Las autoridades peruanas se enfrentan a varias inundaciones que afectan a la capital del país, Lima. Las lluvias prolongadas han afectado las vías y han llevado a la suspensión de clases. En regiones aledañas a la ciudad se han reportado desbordamientos de ríos y deslizamientos de tierra. La presidenta Keiko Fujimori recorrió las calles y visitó a algunas de las personas afectadas. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Torrential rains kill one in South Korea while Philippine capital battles major flooding
item.description: Person dies after landslide hits apartment building in southern city of Geoje as torrential rains lead to power cuts and mass evacuations Torrential downpours that pounded southern parts of South Korea since Saturday have killed one person and injured four others, officials have confirmed. Heavy rains have been recorded in South Gyeongsang province, including the city of Geoje, where an 800mm (31in) deluge over the weekend triggered a landslide, the interior and safety ministry said. The rain continued on Monday, bringing the cumulative rainfall total to 912mm by 6pm. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.description: Study finds older adults could face harmful heat stress at just 1.5C of warming above preindustrial levels People aged 60 and over face dangers to their health from exposure to heat at much lower temperatures than previously thought, research has found. Older adults will bear the brunt of increasingly frequent sustained spells of extreme heat globally as the world continues to warm up, according to a study in The Lancet Public Health.
